import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    # The Java code reads: n, a1, a3, a2, b1, b3, b2 (n is ignored)
    # But the input order is: n, a1, a3, a2, b1, b3, b2
    # We'll parse accordingly
    it = iter(data)
    t = 1  # while loop runs once
    while t > 0:
        t -= 1
        n = int(next(it))  # not used
        a1 = int(next(it))
        a3 = int(next(it))
        a2 = int(next(it))
        b1 = int(next(it))
        b3 = int(next(it))
        b2 = int(next(it))
        min_val = 0
        max_val = 0
        # max calculation
        max_val += min(a1, b3)
        max_val += min(a2, b1)
        max_val += min(a3, b2)
        # min calculation
        min_val += max(a1 - (b2 + b1), 0)
        min_val += max(a2 - (b3 + b2), 0)
        min_val += max(a3 - (b1 + b3), 0)
        print(f"{min_val} {max_val}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</translated_code>
